general.title: OMIX GSEA - Pre-ranked Gene Set Enrichment Analysis
general.instructions:
START HERE: Upload your DEG file using the 'DEG Table File (Upload)' parameter below, OR select the example DEG Table from the Data section. Configure Basic Settings and run enrichment analysis.

GSEA evaluates if gene sets are significantly enriched at either end of a ranked gene list (e.g., fold-change, t-statistic). Outputs include enrichment statistics (NES, p-value, FDR) and leading edge genes for each pathway.

Note: Use Human collections (H/C prefix) for all species - the tool automatically maps genes to human orthologs. See README for complete collection list.

parameters.name: DEG Table File (Upload)
parameters.help_text: Upload your differential expression results file (RDS/CSV/TSV). Must contain gene names and ranking column (t-statistic or log fold-change). If provided, overrides the example DEG Table data asset.

parameters.name: Gene Names Column
parameters.help_text: Column name containing gene symbols in the DEG table

parameters.name: Species
parameters.help_text: Species for gene annotations in your input DEG table. Non-human genes are automatically converted to human orthologs for pathway analysis.

parameters.name: Gene Score Suffix
parameters.help_text: Suffix in column names containing gene ranking scores (e.g., if you have 'TreatmentA_tstat' and 'TreatmentB_tstat' columns, use '_tstat')

parameters.name: Pathways Species
parameters.help_text: Species in the pathways database. Recommended: Keep as 'Human' for H/C collections - non-human input genes are automatically mapped to human orthologs. Use 'Mouse' only for M-prefix collections.

parameters.name: Collections
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated MSigDB collection names. Recommended: Use Human collections (H/C prefix) regardless of input species. Examples: 'H: hallmark gene sets' or 'H: hallmark gene sets,C2:CP:REACTOME: Reactome gene sets'. See README for complete list.
parameters.default_value: H: hallmark gene sets,C2:CP:REACTOME: Reactome gene sets

parameters.name: Min Geneset Size
parameters.help_text: Exclude gene sets with fewer than this many genes (smaller sets may be less reliable)

parameters.name: Max Geneset Size
parameters.help_text: Exclude gene sets with more than this many genes (very large sets often lack specificity)

parameters.name: Number of Permutations
parameters.help_text: Number of permutations for p-value calculation. Higher = more accurate but slower (typical: 1000-10000)

parameters.name: Random Seed
parameters.help_text: Seed for reproducible permutation test results

parameters.name: FDR Correction Mode
parameters.help_text: Apply FDR correction within each collection separately or across all collections together

parameters.name: Collapse Redundancy
parameters.help_text: Use fgsea's collapsePathways to reduce redundant pathways in results

parameters.name: Sort By
parameters.help_text: Column to sort output results table by

parameters.name: Image Width (pixels)
parameters.help_text: Width of output plots in pixels

parameters.name: Image Height (pixels)
parameters.help_text: Height of output plots in pixels

parameters.name: Image Resolution (dpi)
parameters.help_text: Resolution for output plots (typical: 300 for publications, 150 for web)
